author: Michael Larabel
description: The ReactOS open-source operating system has seen its NTFS file-system driver mature to the point that it can be finally used for installing and using ReactOS with it. NTFS formatting support is also finally now possible with this driver too...
title: ReactOS Can Now Be Installed & Used With Its NTFS Driver

author: Michael Larabel
description: MeshXFS is a clustered open-source file-system in which "no human wrote any of its own code". Depending upon your views of AI, not necessarily something you want to hear for entrusting your data in an AI-created solution. Instead, Claude Opus was tasked with adapting the XFS file-system driver into a clustered file-system...
title: MeshXFS: AI Adapts XFS Into A Clustered File-System

author: Michael Larabel
description: Among the flurry of last minute patch activity ahead of tomorrow's presumed Linux 7.3 stable kernel release is a fix for addressing some rare hangs at boot time. The reports varied but ultimately tracked down to a kernel change made two years ago...
title: Linux Lands Fix for Rare, Varying SMP Boot Hangs Affecting Kernels Since 2024

author: Michael Larabel
description: Coming about the past few months has been Moose as a GNOME-aligned AI chat application built around GTK4 and libadwaita. It began as a local AI chat app for the GNOME desktop and grew to support cloud AI services as well. This past week marked the latest feature release for Moose...
title: GNOME's New Local/Cloud AI Chat App Gains More Features
